reuse.why: Every month-wide action, including the new setLastMonthSpending, goes through the existing getBulkBudgetCategories selection, and the new action reuses getSheetValue and averageToBudget for its amount and sign.

duplication.why: Template, hidden, #fixed and income rules are each stated once inside the shared selection; no action re-checks them.

placement.why: The exclusions are added to the bulk-selection helper in budget/actions.ts and the new method is registered in budget/app.ts beside its siblings.

scope.why: Focused on the bulk actions, handler and tests, but includes an unrelated import reorder in schedules/app.ts.

maintainability.why: One documented selection function owns the rules; small nits are the template rule living in SQL while the others are in the JS filter, and averageToBudget being reused for a non-average amount.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All bulk actions call getBulkBudgetCategories; none re-implements the selection.

abstraction_drift.where: getBulkBudgetCategories' includeHidden parameter is renamed to includeHiddenCategories and passed through from callers rather than hardcoded per action; the template and #fixed rules are general exclusions added to the helper, not per-caller special cases.
